theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.oddExt
theorems.informal: oddExt f g = Real.sign g * f |g| (odd extension φ_f of the filter); takes no Spec argument.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.cNextF
theorems.informal: cNextF f η c i = c i − η * oddExt f (λ_i * c i); Spec.cNextF_apply proves the (1.0) form c_i − η·sign(c_i)·f(λ_i|c_i|), Spec.cNextF_one the Muon form.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.nu
theorems.informal: Effective curvature nu f c i = f(λ_i |c_i|) / |c_i| (= 0 at c_i = 0); Spec.nu_one: Muon gives 1/|c_i|; Spec.nu_nonneg; Spec.nu_of_eq_zero.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.momF
theorems.informal: momF f S a c = ∑_{i∈S} ν_i^a λ_i² c_i².

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.qF
theorems.informal: qF f c = 2 (s^D · momF f B 1 c − s^B · momF f D 1 c).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.pF
theorems.informal: pF f c = s^B · momF f D 2 c − s^D · momF f B 2 c.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.etaStarF
theorems.informal: etaStarF f c = −qF f c / pF f c.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.fCompareF
theorems.informal: fCompareF f η c = s^B(c) s^D(c⁺) − s^B(c⁺) s^D(c) with c⁺ = cNextF f η c.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Noise.noiseFree
theorems.informal: The Noise with kap2 = 0, smin = smax = 0; the spec's η*₀ is P.etaStar Noise.noiseFree c (written out in Spec.etaStar_noiseFree_eq; Spec.eD_noiseFree, Spec.eB_noiseFree).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.gradNorm
theorems.informal: gradNorm c ζ = √(∑_i (λ_i c_i + ζ_i)²); Spec.gradNorm_noiseFree: with ζ = 0 it is √(s(c)).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.cNextVec
theorems.informal: cNextVec f η c ζ i = c_i − η f(‖g‖) (λ_i c_i + ζ_i) / ‖g‖.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.etaEff
theorems.informal: etaEff f η c ζ = η f(‖g‖) / ‖g‖.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.cNextF_eq
theorems.informal: For every i (including c_i = 0): cNextF f η c i = (1 − η ν_i) c_i. Key lemma Spec.oddExt_lam_mul: φ_f(λ_i c_i) = ν_i c_i.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.cNextF_id
theorems.informal: cNextF id η c = P.cNext η c 0 (SGD is the identity filter).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.nu_id
theorems.informal: nu id c i = λ_i whenever c_i ≠ 0 (and Spec.momF_id: momF id S a c = P.mom S (a+2) c).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.qF_id
theorems.informal: qF id c = P.qCoef c.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.pF_id
theorems.informal: pF id c = P.pCoef Noise.noiseFree c (also Spec.etaStarF_id, Spec.fCompareF_id).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.momF_zero
theorems.informal: momF f S 0 c = P.mom S 2 c.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.mom_cNextF
theorems.informal: ∑_{i∈S} λ_i² (c_i⁺)² = momF f S 0 c − 2η momF f S 1 c + η² momF f S 2 c.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.fCompareF_eq
theorems.informal: fCompareF f η c = pF f c · η² + qF f c · η, exactly, no hypothesis (SGD case: Spec.fCompare_noiseFree_eq).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_lt_iff_cross_neg
theorems.informal: For arbitrary states c, c' with s(c) > 0, s(c') > 0: θ(c') < θ(c) ⟺ s^B(c) s^D(c') − s^B(c') s^D(c) < 0.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_gt_iff_cross_pos
theorems.informal: Same hypotheses: θ(c) < θ(c') ⟺ 0 < s^B(c) s^D(c') − s^B(c') s^D(c).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_eq_iff_cross_eq_zero
theorems.informal: Same hypotheses: θ(c') = θ(c) ⟺ s^B(c) s^D(c') − s^B(c') s^D(c) = 0.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNextF_lt_iff
theorems.informal: If s(c) > 0 and s(c⁺) > 0: θ(c⁺) < θ(c) ⟺ pF η² + qF η < 0; likewise Spec.theta_cNextF_gt_iff and Spec.theta_cNextF_eq_iff.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.qF_eq_double_sum
theorems.informal: qF = 2 ∑_{i∈D} ∑_{j∈B} s_i s_j (ν_j − ν_i).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.pF_eq_double_sum
theorems.informal: pF = ∑_{i∈D} ∑_{j∈B} s_i s_j (ν_i² − ν_j²).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.etaStarF_eq_double_sum
theorems.informal: etaStarF = 2 ∑ w_ij / ∑ w_ij (ν_i + ν_j) with w_ij = s_i s_j (ν_i − ν_j); no hypothesis.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.qF_neg_of_ordered
theorems.informal: s^D, s^B > 0 and ν_j < ν_i on pairs of non-zero coefficients ⟹ qF < 0 (no sign condition needed).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.pF_pos_of_ordered
theorems.informal: s^D, s^B > 0, ν_j ≥ 0 on the bulk (non-zero coefficients), ν_j < ν_i ⟹ 0 < pF.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.etaStarF_pos_of_ordered
theorems.informal: Under the hypotheses of 1.7: 0 < etaStarF.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.s_cNextF_pos_of_ordered
theorems.informal: Under s^D, s^B > 0 and the ordering, s(c⁺) > 0 for every real η: the spec's proviso is automatic.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNextF_lt_iff_of_ordered
theorems.informal: Hypotheses of 1.7 and η > 0: θ(c⁺) < θ(c) ⟺ η < etaStarF (s(c⁺) > 0 not assumed).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNextF_eq_iff_of_ordered
theorems.informal: Hypotheses of 1.7 and η > 0: θ(c⁺) = θ(c) ⟺ η = etaStarF.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNextF_gt_iff_of_ordered
theorems.informal: Hypotheses of 1.7 and η > 0: θ(c) < θ(c⁺) ⟺ etaStarF < η.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNextF_lt_iff_of_ordered'
theorems.informal: For every real η: decrease ⟺ 0 < η < etaStarF; primed _eq_ (η = 0 ∨ η = etaStarF) and _gt_ (η < 0 ∨ etaStarF < η) versions too.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNext_noiseFree_lt_iff
theorems.informal: SGD with ζ = 0, s^D, s^B > 0, η > 0: θ(cNext η c 0) < θ(c) ⟺ η < η*₀ (exact, every finite d).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNext_noiseFree_eq_iff
theorems.informal: Same setting: θ unchanged ⟺ η = η*₀.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNext_noiseFree_gt_iff
theorems.informal: Same setting: θ increases ⟺ η > η*₀ (no g_gap hypothesis needed without noise); primed all-η versions exist.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.pCoef_noiseFree_pos
theorems.informal: s^D, s^B > 0 ⟹ 0 < P.pCoef Noise.noiseFree c; also Spec.etaStar_noiseFree_pos, Spec.s_cNext_noiseFree_pos, Spec.nu_id_lt_nu_id (ordering holds by the gap).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.qF_pos_of_reversed
theorems.informal: s^D, s^B > 0 and ν_i < ν_j on pairs of non-zero coefficients ⟹ 0 < qF.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.pF_neg_of_reversed
theorems.informal: s^D, s^B > 0, ν_i ≥ 0 on the dominant block only (non-zero coefficients), ν_i < ν_j ⟹ pF < 0. (1.8 read with the sign condition of 1.7 carried over; it is necessary, see paperIssues D2.)

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.etaStarF_pos_of_reversed
theorems.informal: Under the hypotheses of 1.8 (sign condition ν_i ≥ 0 on D carried over from 1.7): 0 < etaStarF.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.s_cNextF_pos_of_reversed
theorems.informal: Under the reversed ordering s(c⁺) > 0 for every real η.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNextF_gt_iff_of_reversed
theorems.informal: Reversed ordering, ν_i ≥ 0 on D, η > 0: θ(c) < θ(c⁺) ⟺ η < etaStarF (alignment INCREASES for small η); s(c⁺) > 0 not assumed.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNextF_lt_iff_of_reversed
theorems.informal: Same hypotheses, η > 0: θ(c⁺) < θ(c) ⟺ etaStarF < η; Spec.theta_cNextF_eq_iff_of_reversed: unchanged ⟺ η = etaStarF; primed versions for all real η.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.not_reversed_id
theorems.informal: For f = id and s^D, s^B > 0 the reversed curvature ordering is impossible; Spec.qF_id_nonpos: qF id c ≤ 0 at every state.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.two_div_le_etaStarF_of_ordered
theorems.informal: Hypotheses of 1.7 and ν_i ≤ b_D on D, ν_j ≤ b_B on B ⟹ 2/(b_D + b_B) ≤ etaStarF (a's not needed).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.etaStarF_le_two_div_of_ordered
theorems.informal: s^D, s^B > 0, ordering, a_D ≤ ν_i on D, a_B ≤ ν_j on B, a_D + a_B > 0 ⟹ etaStarF ≤ 2/(a_D + a_B) (sign condition not needed).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.etaStarF_mem_Icc_of_ordered
theorems.informal: 2/(b_D + b_B) ≤ etaStarF ≤ 2/(a_D + a_B) under the spec's hypotheses.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.two_div_le_etaStarF_of_reversed
theorems.paperItem: filter_spec 1.9 analogue in the reversed case of 1.8
theorems.informal: Under the hypotheses of 1.8 the same lower bound holds; Spec.etaStarF_le_two_div_of_reversed gives the upper bound.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.two_div_le_etaStar_noiseFree
theorems.informal: s^D, s^B > 0 ⟹ 2/(λ_1 + λ_{k+1}) ≤ η*₀ = P.etaStar Noise.noiseFree c.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.thm7_noiseFree_bound_le_two_div
theorems.informal: For every spectrum: 2 gap₁/(λ_1² − λ_d²) ≤ 2/(λ_1 + λ_{k+1}).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.thm7_noiseFree_bound_eq
theorems.informal: With Noise.noiseFree the right-hand side of Theorem 7 equals 2 gap₁/(λ_1² − λ_d²) (bookkeeping).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.thm7_noiseFree_bound_le_etaStar
theorems.informal: s^D, s^B > 0 ⟹ 2 gap₁/(λ_1² − λ_d²) ≤ η*₀, obtained from the new bound.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.thm7_noiseFree_bound_lt_two_div
theorems.informal: The comparison is strict if λ_k < λ_1 or λ_d < λ_{k+1}; Spec.thm7_noiseFree_bound_eq_two_div_iff: equality ⟺ two-level spectrum.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.cNextVec_eq_cNext
theorems.informal: cNextVec f η c ζ = P.cNext (etaEff f η c ζ) c ζ for all f, η, c, ζ (also when ‖g‖ = 0); transfers Spec.theta_cNextVec, Spec.fCompare_etaEff.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.etaEff_one
theorems.informal: For f ≡ 1: etaEff = η / ‖g‖.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.etaEff_rpow
theorems.informal: For f σ = σ^p: etaEff = η ‖g‖^(p−1), provided ‖g‖ ≠ 0 or p ≠ 1 (Spec.etaEff_id: η_eff = η for f = id, ‖g‖ ≠ 0).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNextVec_noiseFree_lt_iff
theorems.informal: ζ = 0, s^D, s^B > 0: θ(c⁺) < θ(c) ⟺ 0 < η_eff < η*₀; _gt_ (η_eff < 0 ∨ η*₀ < η_eff) and _eq_ versions.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNextVec_rpow_lt_iff
theorems.informal: ζ = 0, f σ = σ^p (any real p), s^D, s^B > 0, η > 0: θ(c⁺) < θ(c) ⟺ η √(s(c))^(p−1) < η*₀(c).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNextVec_rpow_gt_iff
theorems.informal: Same setting: θ(c) < θ(c⁺) ⟺ η*₀(c) < η √(s(c))^(p−1); Spec.theta_cNextVec_rpow_eq_iff for equality.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNextVec_rpow_gt_of_neg
theorems.paperItem: filter_spec 4.2 as literally stated (no restriction on η)
theorems.informal: For every η < 0 the alignment increases although η ‖Ax‖^(p−1) < η*₀(c): the spec's equivalence fails without η > 0.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.etaStar_noiseFree_smul
theorems.informal: η*₀(a • c) = η*₀(c) for a ≠ 0.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNextVec_rpow_ray_lt_iff
theorems.informal: p < 1, η > 0, a > 0, s^D, s^B > 0: alignment at a•c decreases ⟺ (η/η*₀(c))^(1/(1−p)) < a √(s(c)).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNextVec_rpow_ray_gt_iff
theorems.informal: Same setting: alignment at a•c increases ⟺ a √(s(c)) < (η/η*₀(c))^(1/(1−p)).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.Spec.theta_cNextVec_rpow_one_lt_iff
theorems.informal: For f σ = σ^1, η > 0: decrease ⟺ η < η*₀(c) (regime selected by η alone); Spec.theta_cNextVec_rpow_one_gt_iff for increase.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.FilterCoordinate.exSpec_muon_decrease
theorems.informal: Spec λ = (2,1) on Fin 2, D = {0}; Muon at c = (1,2): ordering holds, η* = 4/3 (exSpec_muon_ordered), alignment decreases for all 0 < η < 4/3.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.FilterCoordinate.exSpec_muon_increase
theorems.informal: Muon at c = (2,1) on exSpec: reversed ordering, η* = 4/3 (exSpec_muon_reversed), the alignment INCREASES for every 0 < η < 4/3.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.FilterCoordinate.exSpec_muon_increase_explicit
theorems.informal: On exSpec: θ(2,1) = 16/17 and after one Muon step with η = 1/2 it is 36/37.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.FilterCoordinate.exSpec_ordered_without_sign
theorems.informal: On exSpec at c = (1,1) with f σ = (11σ − 21)/10: ν = (1/10, −1) is ordered but pF = −99/25 < 0.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.FilterCoordinate.exSpec_reversed_without_sign
theorems.informal: On exSpec at c = (1,1) with f σ = (12 − 11σ)/10: ν = (−1, 1/10) is reversed but pF = 99/25 > 0.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.FilterCoordinate.exSpec_muon_annihilate
theorems.informal: Muon on exSpec at c = (1,1), η = 1: c⁺ = 0, θ(c⁺) = 0 < θ(c) although pF η² + qF η = 0.

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.FilterCoordinate.exSpec_etaStar_noiseFree
theorems.paperItem: non-vacuity of the SGD corollary of 1.9
theorems.informal: On exSpec at c = (1,2): η*₀ = 2/3 = 2/(λ_0 + λ_1) (both bounds attained).

theorems.name: SuspiciousAlignment.FilterCoordinate.exSpec_vector_ray
theorems.informal: Normalised SGD (f σ = σ^0) on exSpec along the ray through (1,2): for η, a > 0, decrease ⟺ 3η/2 < a √8.

paperIssues: D4 (spec 4.2, missing hypothesis): the equivalence 'θ(c⁺) < θ(c) ⟺ η‖Ax‖^{p−1} < η*₀(c)' (and '>' likewise) is stated without restricting η. It needs η > 0: for every η < 0 the alignment strictly increases while η‖Ax‖^{p−1} < 0 < η*₀ (Spec.theta_cNextVec_rpow_gt_of_neg, proved for every state with s^D, s^B > 0 and every p; numerically λ=(2,1), c=(1,1), p=1/2, η=−0.1 gives θ⁺−θ=+0.0187); at η = 0 the '<' form fails as well. The exact all-η statement is θ(c⁺) < θ(c) ⟺ 0 < η_eff < η*₀ (Spec.theta_cNextVec_noiseFree_lt_iff). The Lean versions of 4.2 and of the ray statement carry 0 < η.

D2 (spec 1.8, sign condition): 1.8 says 'if instead ν_i < ν_j …' and does not repeat 'ν_i ≥ 0'. The sign condition is needed for pF < 0 (FilterCoordinate.exSpec_reversed_without_sign: reversed ordering with ν = (−1, 1/10) gives pF = 99/25 > 0), so 1.8 must be read with it carried over from 1.7; Lean assumes ν_i ≥ 0 only on the dominant block at non-zero coefficients. Symmetrically, in 1.7 only ν_j ≥ 0 on the bulk at non-zero coefficients is needed (and it cannot be dropped: exSpec_ordered_without_sign, pF = −99/25 < 0); qF < 0 resp. qF > 0 needs no sign condition at all.

D1 (spec 1.7 / 1.8, redundant proviso): 'given s(c⁺) > 0' is automatic under s^D, s^B > 0 and either strict curvature ordering, for every real η (Spec.s_cNextF_pos_of_ordered, Spec.s_cNextF_pos_of_reversed); the Lean dichotomies do not assume it.

D3 (spec 1.5): the hypothesis s(c') > 0 is genuinely needed in general: Muon at the isotropic state c = (1,1), η = 1 lands on c⁺ = 0, so θ(c⁺) = 0 < θ(c) while pF η² + qF η = 0 (FilterCoordinate.exSpec_muon_annihilate). The spec states the hypothesis; this is a confirmation, not an error.

D2' (spec 1.9, hypotheses can be weakened): the lower bound 2/(b_D + b_B) ≤ η* needs neither a_D, a_B nor a_D + a_B > 0 (and b_D + b_B > 0 is automatic); the upper bound does not need the sign condition ν ≥ 0 (it is implied where needed by a_D + a_B > 0). The same two bounds also hold in the reversed case of 1.8 (extra theorems).

D5 (spec 4.1, Lean-convention edge case): 'HTMuon: η_eff = η‖g‖^{p−1}' fails at ‖g‖ = 0 with p = 1 (etaEff = 0 by x/0 = 0, but η·0⁰ = η); Spec.etaEff_rpow assumes ‖g‖ ≠ 0 ∨ p ≠ 1. The main identity 4.1 (Spec.cNextVec_eq_cNext) needs no hypothesis.

D6 (spec 4.2): p < 1 is not needed for the first equivalences (they hold for every real p; p = 1 gives Deng's noise-free dichotomy η < η*₀, Spec.theta_cNextVec_rpow_one_lt_iff); p < 1 is used only in the ray statement.
D7 (conventions): Real.sign 0 = 0, so φ_f(0) = 0 even when f 0 ≠ 0 (Muon): a zero coefficient stays zero and ν_i = 0 there. Statements 1.1–1.6 hold with these conventions without any hypothesis on c.

D8 (spec 4.1, meta-claim): 'every pathwise statement of Deng's one-step theory holds with η replaced by η_eff' is formalized as the identity cNextVec = cNext at η_eff plus the transfers Spec.theta_cNextVec and Spec.fCompare_etaEff. η_eff depends on the realised noise ζ, so expectation-level statements (E[f_t(η)] = p_t η² + q_t η) do NOT transfer by substitution; nothing of that kind is claimed.

SGD corollary of 1.9: the hypotheses s^D > 0 and s^B > 0 are required (they are the hypotheses of 1.7; without them η*₀ = 0/0 = 0 and the lower bound is false). The spec's corollary does not repeat them explicitly.
No statement of sections 1 and 4 was found false in its intended reading (η > 0 step sizes, sign condition carried from 1.7 to 1.8).
